results.title: The architecture of resilience: Why India’s private credit stands apart
results.summary: India’s private credit market stands resilient amid global stress due to its conservative fund structures, strict leverage norms, and closed-ended AIF framework. Unlike global peers facing liquidity and redemption pressures, India’s system aligns investor timelines with asset maturity, reducing systemic risks while offering significant growth headroom in an underpenetrated market.
results.reason: Opinion/analysis piece on the structure of India's private credit market.
